_comment: Read by hooks/protected-path-guard.sh (R-411) and enforce/tdd.sh. `patterns` are extended regexes matched against a path relative to the repo root. `roles` are keyed by the `agent_type` the hook input carries in subagent context; a role with `allow` may write only matching paths, a role with `deny` may write anything else. An agent_type absent from this table gets no role restriction (lock and gate-input rules still apply).
